description: This is a unit test script for a Python project testing the behavior of the Router class in the litellm package. It specifically verifies that removing certain .copy() calls from completion methods does not cause side effects or mutations in deployment data structures. It uses pytest and mock objects to simulate dependencies and evaluate the correctness of asynchronous and synchronous completion functions.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class responsible for managing different language model deployments and facilitating completions.

methods.name: test_acompletion_deployment_not_mutated()
methods.description: Asynchronous test to verify that removing the .copy() call in the asynchronous completion method does not mutate the deployment parameters.

methods.name: test_completion_deployment_not_mutated()
methods.description: Synchronous test to ensure that removing the .copy() call in the synchronous completion method does not alter the deployment parameters.
